arguments.description: Append S1830 entries to queue, STATE, ledger
arguments.command:
$queueText = @'

## 2026-11-01 S1830: R'-level (G2) and (G3) of S1779, actually proved

- [proof complete; both S1779 missing algebra-side fields discharged]
  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1830G2G3RPrimeActual.lean:
  S1830QuotientsMissing : S1779QuotientsMissing,
  S1830MonoMissing : S1779MonoMissing,
  S1830AlgPreGaloisMissing : S1779AlgPreGaloisMissing,
  S1830PreGaloisCategory : PreGaloisCategory S1779AlgR.
  G2: general fixed-point theorem
  FiniteEtaleFixedPointsGeneral.fixedPointSubalgebra_finiteEtale for an arbitrary
  CommRing (Galois descent along a finite faithfully flat etale splitting cover;
  no |G|-invertibility).  G3: epi -> surjective (tensor self-pushout test object +
  Algebra.isEpi_iff_surjective_algebraMap_of_finite), idempotent-kernel splitting,
  and the binary product fan limit in the full subcategory.  R' is a Dedekind
  coordinate ring, not a field; no field-case argument is used.
- [consumer] tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/_S1830Consumer.lean (EXIT=0): inhabits
  S1825AlgPreGaloisMissing and derives PreGaloisCategory S1728Cover from any
  e : S1825AffineEquiv.  Remaining S1825 inputs after S1830: the affine
  equivalence (S1777/S1778) and the geometric fiber functor
  (S1779FiberFunctorMissing), not G2/G3.
- [evidence] 26936 bytes, SHA256
  4DD1A4199904D09D137C40E94A4C3D0732911E96438454B5B85E2E69D20871F2;
  EXIT=0, no errors/warnings/sorryAx; olean 758360 bytes, SHA256
  42A077F766076908762D18106EB54174BE800E88AFF0D7F9A6907A6A3979EB37;
  axioms trio only.  Report coord/reports/S1830-g2-g3-rprime-actual.md.
'@
Add-Content -Path 'coord/queue.md' -Value $queueText -Encoding utf8

$stateText = @'

## 2026-11-01 — S1830: R'-level (G2) and (G3) proved; S1825 residual G2/G3 closed

- [proof complete; both S1779 missing fields discharged]
  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1830G2G3RPrimeActual.lean:
  S1830QuotientsMissing : S1779QuotientsMissing and
  S1830MonoMissing : S1779MonoMissing, hence
  S1830AlgPreGaloisMissing : S1779AlgPreGaloisMissing and
  S1830PreGaloisCategory : PreGaloisCategory S1779AlgR.
  G2 uses FiniteEtaleFixedPointsGeneral.fixedPointSubalgebra_finiteEtale
  (arbitrary commutative ring, Galois descent along a finite faithfully flat
  etale splitting cover); G3 uses epi -> surjective, idempotent-kernel
  splitting, and the product fan limit in the full subcategory of finite etale
  algebras.  R' is not a field and the field-case S1746/S1770/S1785/S1811
  arguments are not used.
- [consumer] _S1830Consumer.lean compiles EXIT=0 and derives
  PreGaloisCategory S1728Cover from e : S1825AffineEquiv using S1825's
  S1825PreGaloisCategory_of_missing; S1825AlgPreGaloisMissing is inhabited.
  The remaining S1825 inputs are the affine equivalence (S1777/S1778) and the
  geometric fibre functor (S1779FiberFunctorMissing), not G2/G3.
- [evidence] source 26936 bytes, SHA256
  4DD1A4199904D09D137C40E94A4C3D0732911E96438454B5B85E2E69D20871F2;
  EXIT=0, no warnings/errors/sorryAx; olean 758360 bytes, SHA256
  42A077F766076908762D18106EB54174BE800E88AFF0D7F9A6907A6A3979EB37;
  #print axioms on all main declarations = propext, Classical.choice,
  Quot.sound only.  Report: coord/reports/S1830-g2-g3-rprime-actual.md.
'@
Add-Content -Path 'coord/STATE.md' -Value $stateText -Encoding utf8

$ledgerText = @'

S1830 (2026-11-01): R'-level G2/G3 of S1779 closed.
- S1830G2: for every commutative ring R and finite group G acting on a finite
  etale R-algebra A, A^G is finite etale over R (via
  FiniteEtaleFixedPointsGeneral.fixedPointSubalgebra_finiteEtale, Galois descent
  along a finite faithfully flat etale splitting cover), and the invariant
  algebra is the limit of the action in CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale R; hence
  HasColimitsOfShape (SingleObj G) (FiniteEtale R)^op.
- S1830G3: epimorphisms of finite etale R-algebras are surjective (self-pushout
  test object + finite-epi theorem); a surjection B -> A splits as B ~= A x C
  (idempotent kernel, finitely generated by a projective R-linear section);
  the product fan is a limit, giving monoInducesIsoOnDirectSummand.
- Hence S1779QuotientsMissing, S1779MonoMissing, S1779AlgPreGaloisMissing and
  PreGaloisCategory (FiniteEtale R')^op are unconditional; consumer derives
  PreGaloisCategory S1728Cover from the S1825 affine equivalence.  Field-case
  subalgebra/product-of-fields arguments are not used (R' is a Dedekind
  coordinate ring, not a field).
- S1806 has a compiling G2 but did not compile as a whole: its final G3
  declarations were absent (unknown-constant placeholders / sorryAx).  S1830
  is self-contained on S1779 plus the general fixed-point theorem and supersedes
  S1806 for this target.
- Evidence: source 26936 bytes SHA256
  4DD1A4199904D09D137C40E94A4C3D0732911E96438454B5B85E2E69D20871F2; EXIT=0,
  no warnings/sorryAx; olean 758360 bytes SHA256
  42A077F766076908762D18106EB54174BE800E88AFF0D7F9A6907A6A3979EB37; axioms
  propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only.  Report:
  coord/reports/S1830-g2-g3-rprime-actual.md.
'@
Add-Content -Path 'AUDIT_LEDGER.md' -Value $ledgerText -Encoding utf8
